rawContent: So imagine if something happened. Now folks are telling me that an adult, young, but still an adult, pursuing a married man is a victim and deserves an apology? That is crazy. That's not #MeToo.

Do I think WJC needs defending? No. Do I think that there was a power dynamic, plus married, so he needed to say no? Yes.  He apologized pubically. But 22, you are not a child. You pursued a married man and knew what you were doing. It was stupid. It was a mistake, not #MeToo
